scene: The honey sparkles on your tongue, summoning a friendly clockwork bee. What now?
picture: Flat side view. On the left sits the striped beehive with sticky golden drips. The player stands centre-left, holding her red umbrella and licking her sticky fingertip. Up high hovers a glowing brass clockwork bee. At centre stands the closed, pink-glowing greenhouse door. On the far right sprouts the giant purple radish.
shown: a mechanical brass bee buzzing impatiently up high above the player
a glass greenhouse with its pink glowing door still closed at centre
a leafy giant purple radish rooted firmly in soil on the far right
